title: Microsoft verified-storage
summary: A repository containing CapybaraKV, a persistent-memory key-value store with Verus specifications and proofs for list operations, journaled state updates, and recovery.

source.statement: This directory contains the current version of the verified key-value store called CapybaraKV.

reuse: Install Verus compatible with the pinned vstd dependency, use the Rust nightly specified by capybaraKV/capybarakv/rust-toolchain.toml, then verify from capybaraKV/capybarakv with cargo verus verify --no-default-features on Linux/WSL without PMDK; follow the README's PMDK setup and plain cargo verus verify command on platforms with the optional PMDK dependencies.

contents: CapybaraKV verified persistent-memory key-value store; Verus verification and recovery code; persistent-memory abstractions and concurrent specifications.
project_details.setup: Install Verus; use nightly-2026-07-12; in capybaraKV/capybarakv run cargo verus verify --no-default-features when the optional PMDK dependencies are not installed. The repository pins vstd =0.0.0-2026-09-20-0158. The README describes PMDK setup for the default pmem feature.
